stem: The notion that the director is the center of the team has been ____, but in fact it has not been accepted by academia.
The paradoxical characteristic of the reliable employee Donna is her ____, as we consider her usual feigning illness to escape from her labor.

Researchers in University of Maryland discover that many people subconsciously think that in assessment of others competence and warmth are (i)____: when they feel someone is highly capable, they will assert that he or she must have a tendency to be (ii)____.

Some chemists argue that although molecular motors are (i)____, they are (ii)____ by themselves; nevertheless, the chemical principles behind them might be (iii)____: using the same light-activated mechanism that drives certain molecular motors, researchers have developed around 100 drug-like compound that can be switched on or off in response to light.
In The Balance Within, Sternberg ____ hyperbole, opting for an admirable simplicity and clarity while introducing neuroimmunology as a potential foundation of psychosomatic medicine.
Williams argues that philosophy has become ____ occupation these days, and that it should rather be “part of a more general attempt to make the best sense of our life.”

As modern organizations amass more and more digital information, they need guidance on how to deal with the information surplus in a way that is more ____ than simply increasing their storage capacity.
